bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
root="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
cd "$root"
test "$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service)" = active
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service)" = enabled
git fetch --no-tags origin refs/heads/feat/profile-recruitment-album-20261114 >/dev/null 2>&1
test "$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "9f9ec5281559b86817a65365d2c6c3e31f7a6b5c"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
for path in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
  git show 53451aa78635ba7e94b7db63544e0e7c020d54d7:"$path" > "$tmp/old-$(basename "$path")"
  cmp "$tmp/old-$(basename "$path")" "$path" >/dev/null || exit 75
  cp -p "$path" "$tmp/backup-$(basename "$path")"
  git show FETCH_HEAD:"$path" > "$tmp/new-$(basename "$path")"
done
deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python -B -m py_compile "$tmp/new-userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$tmp/new-userbot_test_client.py"
restore(){
  for path in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
    cp -p "$tmp/backup-$(basename "$path")" "$path"
  done
  systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
}
for path in scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py scripts/userbot_test_client.py; do
  cp "$tmp/new-$(basename "$path")" "$path"
done
if ! systemctl --user restart gace-userbot-verify.service; then restore; exit 81; fi
sleep 3
if ! deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python scripts/userbot_test_client.py health > "$tmp/health"; then
  restore; exit 82
fi
if ! deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python scripts/userbot_test_client.py profile_button_smoke > "$tmp/button"; then
  { echo PROFILE_BUTTON_USERBOT_SMOKE=FAIL; cat "$tmp/button"; echo USERBOT_RESTORING_CODE=YES; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
  restore; exit 83
fi
{ echo PROFILE_BUTTON_USERBOT_SMOKE=PASS; cat "$tmp/button"; echo USERBOT_SERVICE=$(systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service); echo USERBOT_ENABLED=$(systemctl --user is-enabled gace-userbot-verify.service); echo USERBOT_HEALTH=$(grep -o 'USERBOT_TEST_RESULT=PASS' "$tmp/health"); echo SESSION_FILE_UNCHANGED=YES; } | gh issue comment 4 --repo seigo-gace/GateApp-Bot --body-file - >/dev/null
